With a new conversational-AI line driving demand, expectations on pipeline jump faster than business-development headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Agora needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Lawrence, last bit of proof for Agora.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.
